## Checklist

- [ ] Code, comments and messages are in English; no secrets or internal URLs
- [ ] Exported symbols have TSDoc
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm run changeset`) for user-visible changes
- [ ] English docs updated; Vietnamese counterpart updated or noted as pending
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
